HttpServerRequestMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts an incoming HTTP request body to controller argument type T.
    If the request body should be JSON, annotate the controller body argument with @Json and make sure JsonReader<T> exists.
    If this is not JSON, provide a custom HttpServerRequestMapper<T> component or use @Mapping(...).

If this controller was generated from an OpenAPI specification, ensure that the request body declares Content-Type: application/json when JSON mapping is expected.
    Example: requestBody -> content -> application/json.
    If the content section is missing or has another media type, the generator will not apply @Json for the request mapper.

HttpServerResponseMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts controller return type T to an HTTP response body.
    If the response should be JSON, annotate the controller return type with @Json and make sure JsonWriter<T> exists.
    If this is not JSON, provide a custom HttpServerResponseMapper<T> component or use @Mapping(...).

If this controller was generated from an OpenAPI specification, ensure that the response declares Content-Type: application/json when JSON mapping is expected.
    Example: responses -> '200' -> content -> application/json.
    If the content section is missing or has another media type, the generator will not apply @Json for the response mapper.

@Json was applied to HttpServerResponse. HttpServerResponse is already a raw HTTP response type and should not be JSON-serialized.
    Remove @Json from this controller return type, or return a domain payload object annotated/mapped as JSON.

    Remove @Json from this controller argument, or use a domain request body object annotated/mapped as JSON.
